name: RavenComponentBook
summary: The book of every RavenRS component, kept as Storybook keeps stories, and the guardian of the RavenRS design system: it writes the whole system the design tool reads (index, guide, tokens from ravenrs-style, fonts, cover and every component measured from what RavenRS paints), and checks that what is published is exactly what it writes.
when_to_use: Before designing a screen in Claude Design: export the design system so the design uses only components that exist, with their real measurements.
To know what a component can be set to and how big, round, filled and spaced RavenRS draws it, by token.
After adding or changing a component: give it a ComponentBook and check its stories draw and measure.

commands.does: Opens the book: components by family with a search, the chosen story drawn live, its settings (Controles) changing it at once, its measurements (Medidas) and its code (Código). The status bar says how many components give stories and how many are pending, and the version opens the news of each version. Closing the window keeps it beside the clock.

Writes the whole design system under <folder>/project/, as the design tool takes it with no change: design-system.json (editing: code, so the page does not change it), README.md (the guide, the rule to compose only these components, how to change the system), tokens.json read from ravenrs-style and tokens.css, fonts/Inter-Regular.ttf, Inter-SemiBold.ttf and RavenIcons.ttf, components/Cover/preview.html drawn from the tokens, and per component README.md, preview.html and <Component>.json. <folder>/files.txt lists every file: a published file not in it is removed.

Compares a copy of the published design system (<folder>/project/) with what the book writes now and lists each file that changed, is missing or should not be there; exit code 0 only when they are the same. The design tool's own api/ and manifest.json, and the time and commit of the last change, do not count.
Writes <Component>.json for every component (settings, API, code, every story measured in Raven Dark and Raven Light, anatomy) and index.json, as Storybook's index.
Draws and measures every story in both themes with no window; exit code 0 when every one paints.

limits: It writes files and verifies a copy; publishing them to the design system artifact is done with the Artifact tool, sending the whole folder and removing what files.txt does not list.
Measurements are taken at 760 points wide.
